r0-context.finding: Loaded global-crew.md, global-everyone.md, handoff, IMPLEMENTER_RESULT, and both diffs. No docs/agents overlay in repo (confirmed absent), so CREW_CONTEXT/GLOSSARY deltas do not apply.

r1-handoff.title: Handoff compliance
r1-handoff.imperative: Did the change do what the handoff asked, within scope? Verify each close criterion against the diff and re-run tests.
r1-handoff.finding: All six close criteria verified against the diff + tests: (1) same work-id dedup via ticked-work-ids ring, test_tick_same_work_id_ages_lesson_once + test_same_work_id_burst_cannot_expire green; distinct work-ids age each (test_tick_distinct_work_ids_age_each). (2) same-epoch guard shields added/last-confirmed==tick date, later-dated tick still expires (test_same_epoch_guard_* + test_expires_on_later_dated_tick). (3) constellation still pinned (continue before both new checks, unchanged). (4) real header run-tick=20...apply-confirmed=3 parses (test_existing_real_header_parses_with_empty_ticked); legacy header migrates silently (test_ticked_work_ids_migrates_and_round_trips). (5) malformed field raises LessonsDeltaError (test_malformed_ticked_work_ids_raises). (6) full suite green 384 passed.

r2-scope.title: Scope drift
r2-scope.imperative: Did the change stay inside allowed scope (only the two files) and respect specific exclusions?
r2-scope.finding: git status --porcelain shows only M scripts/apply_lessons_delta.py and M tests/test_apply_lessons_delta.py. No exclusions touched: .agent-work/LESSONS.md, verify_lessons_applied.py, checklist_engine.py, docs untouched. Applier never run against real playbook (all tests use tmpdir --file).

r3-evidence.title: Required evidence
r3-evidence.imperative: Re-run both pytest commands independently; confirm counts match the claim and TDD red was credible.
r3-evidence.finding: Re-ran both commands independently. python -m pytest tests/test_apply_lessons_delta.py -q => 52 passed (matches claim: 42 pre-existing + 10 new). python -m pytest tests/ -q => 384 passed, 1 skipped, 18 subtests (matches claim exactly; baseline 374+10). TDD red credible: 10 new behavior-focused tests exercise the specific behaviors; reseeded test_tick_auto_deletes_unconfirmed still passes and genuinely tests dormancy delete (verified in isolation).

r4-quality.title: Quality vs inherited rules
r4-quality.imperative: Does the change meet the handoff's constraints? Sub-checks below carry one rule each.
r4-quality.finding: Meets handoff constraints; see r4a-r4d sub-checks.

r4a-mechanism.title: Mechanism-not-quality
r4a-mechanism.imperative: Dedup by exact work-id string identity; guard by date-string equality only. No judgment logic.
r4a-mechanism.finding: Dedup is exact-string membership (work_id in book.ticked_work_ids); guard is date-string equality (tick_date in (_stamp_date(added), _stamp_date(last_confirmed))). No judgment/quality logic. _stamp_date is a pure split helper. Constellation continue preserved verbatim.

r4b-backcompat.title: Backward-compatible state + migration
r4b-backcompat.imperative: Existing headers parse via optional regex group; migration is mechanical (silent field emission); malformed field fails visibly.
r4b-backcompat.finding: STATE_RE adds optional non-capturing group (?:\s+ticked-work-ids=(\S*))? so legacy 5-field headers still match. render_playbook + _default_preamble always emit the field => silent mechanical migration on first write. Malformed value (empty comma entry) raises LessonsDeltaError on load (fail-visible, no silent fallback). Absent/empty => empty ring.

r4c-ripeness-runtick.title: Ripeness unaffected + run_tick claim
r4c-ripeness-runtick.imperative: Verify _apply_threshold_ripe/ripe_lessons never read run_tick, and that nothing reads run_tick for a decision.
r4c-ripeness-runtick.finding: VERIFIED the implementer's run_tick claim. grep run_tick: only dataclass field (115), parse (215), construct (244), render (257), increment (527), tick log (551), summary display (596). Read ripe_lessons (270) and _apply_threshold_ripe (294) directly: they key only on confirmed/recurrences/target/apply_confirmed/apply_recurrences/status/deferred_at — never run_tick. Per-lesson dormancy uses runs_since_confirmed, not run_tick. So run_tick is display/state only; the rekey changing what it counts (once per aging round, not per invocation) shifts no documented behavior. 8 ripe tests remain green.

r4d-style.title: Code style + documented constant
r4d-style.imperative: Matches surrounding style; the new TICKED_WORK_ID_RETENTION constant is documented at its definition.
r4d-style.finding: TICKED_WORK_ID_RETENTION=50 documented with a 3-line comment at its definition (matches the DEFAULT_* constant style above it). Guard/dedup comments match surrounding in-file convention. _stamp_date mirrors _stamp. Tick block refactor preserves existing structure; no style drift.

r5-reconciliation.title: Reconciliation + Map Impact
r5-reconciliation.imperative: Do the Map Impact notes match the diff? Any divergence from recorded architecture Commander must reconcile?
r5-reconciliation.finding: Map Impact notes match the diff exactly: STATE_RE/Playbook/load_playbook/render_playbook/_default_preamble extended, _stamp_date added, tick branch rewritten — all present and no overstated claims. constraint:constellation-lessons-pinned honored (constellation continue intact); constraint:backward-compatible-playbook-state honored; constraint:mechanism-not-quality honored. decision:dormancy-key=distinct-work-ids+same-epoch-guard implemented as specified, not substituted. No docs/contracts touched (LESSONS.template.md left for separate docs gate per exclusions). No architecture divergence requiring Commander reconcile beyond the sanctioned decision.

consolidation.summary: Dormancy rekey verified: work-id dedup ring + same-epoch guard implemented per the sanctioned decision; all 6 close criteria met; both pytest runs reproduced (52 module / 384 full); run_tick claim independently verified (nothing reads it for a decision); scope clean (2 files); backward-compatible mechanical migration with fail-visible malformed handling.

triage_candidates.statement: The ticked-work-ids ring stores work-ids comma-joined; a future work-id containing a comma or whitespace would mis-split on header round-trip. No such work-id exists today (all are identifier-like), so out of scope here. Harden by rejecting comma/whitespace work-ids in validate_delta if the work-id shape ever loosens.
